reviews.text: Absolutely amazing place. My cat loves it there!!!!! Very friendly very clean.

Wonderful care for my two cats.
Lovely accommodation. Judith very kind and thoughtful

Jim very supportive when needed to alter bookings due to unforseen circumstances.
Would highly recommend.
Owner is great and very knowledgeable. Cats are well separated. Accommodation is spacious and had plenty of stimulation.

Used Greengates twice already and just booked another 2 stays for our cat.
They have enclosures with both indoor and outdoor spaces. Heated beds and our cat seems very relaxed here which is why we will only be using this place going forward.

This is a really lovely, clean, calm and caring cattery. The cats have an indoor part and a door to an outside part within their pen. The owners love cats and really listen to what your cat likes and doesn’t. It’s also got the bonus of being only cats so not lots of dogs barking. We will not take our cat anywhere else now.

We had used a number of different catteries before finding Greengates but always struggled with an aspect of the accommodation or care. With Greengates we were finally happy that our lovely cat was in safe and caring hands. They really got to know him and understood him. The pens were maintained to a high standard and we felt that his stays with them accommodated his preferences and our wishes. Plus they were so kind when they heard he had passed away.
Had my cats in Monday to Friday and the owners are lovely .. the cats were well looked after and would definitely use again would also recommend prices are reasonable aswell  thanks again

A level of care for cats which re-writes the scriptures of feline philanthropy. Jim and Judith, we salute you for your unheard of application and attention to fine detail for the safe-keeping and love shown to our cats. Absolutely brilliant job.
The only place we would trust with Larry. Beyond 1st class.

I wasn't going to leave a review but I feel I have to. The woman at Greengates is lovely and is the reason we chose this cattery in the end. But the man who runs it with her is perhaps the rudest, most uncaring person I've ever had the displeasure of meeting. On the day we dropped our cats off, he made an inappropriate comment about my weight, refused to let us leave our cats' blankets, beds and scratch posts (we were able to in the end but only because I persisted), was completely dismissive about their unique needs and dietary plans, and kept touting (like an insecure teen) about his "20+ years working with cats" as an excuse for not listening to what I had to say about MY cats. He made an already emotional day 100 x worse than it needed to be, and I sobbed on the way home. I would add - he claims he's worked with cats extensively, and yet when I said I wanted to leave their blankets because the scent of home would comfort them, he said: "Pffsh, cats don't care about scent." Seriously? Utterly unprofessional, unkind and not the type of person I would want to leave my cats with. I'm still furious about the entire interaction. If I'm paying you nearly £400 to look after my cats, I expect to be treated in a polite manner and to be able to leave their personal belongings so that they feel comforted. Will never be using this cattery again.
A very caring couple own the Cattery and are meticulous in their cleanliness of each runs/pens.
